I checked agents.ts and the dashboard isn't in this repo, and grepping for "tags" across src only turned up flows.ts, confirming the consumer lives elsewhere. There's no git history to diff, so I'm relying on the schema itself—z.string() with a "comma separated" description constraining the model's output—and now I want to peek at ai.ts to see if anything there affects the prompt.

The actual fix is to change the tags field to z.array(z.string()) instead of z.string(), keeping the "Up to three lowercase topic tags" description but stripping the misleading "comma separated" part, since that phrasing was pushing the model toward a string output rather than an array. I'll replace that single line of the schema definition verbatim with the corrected array type and updated description.

After making the edit, I'll verify it with a plain typecheck run rather than invoking the actual model flow, since that would require API credentials I don't have handy.

The bug is in `src/flows.ts` line 8: `tags` is declared as a single string, and its description tells the model to return comma-separated text. No other code in the repo reads `tags`, and the dashboard that consumes it lives outside this repo. I'll change the schema to a string array and drop the "comma separated" instruction.
